charts.title: K2-184 b: orbits around K2-184
charts.description: The orbits of K2-184's planets in this map from above, to scale, with K2-184 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Castro-González et al. 2022 (2022MNRAS.509.1075C), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname CASTRO_GONZ_AACUTE_LEZ_ET_AL__2022): P 16.9780102 d
